name: melton
caption:
MELTON 🎮🏀 He got hurt, we traded him away. Then we brought him back.

• 2024: 6 games with us, then a torn ACL
• Dec 15, 2024: traded to Brooklyn, plays 0 games there
• Back with us in 2025: career-high 12.3 PPG
• Re-signed this summer. First 10 games: 41.7% from three, 1.5 SPG

Should he be starting? 👇

beats.head: TRADED HURT
beats.name: MELTON
beats.vo: Six games into his time with us, De'Anthony Melton tore up his knee. Then we traded him to Brooklyn.
beats.dlg: 6 GAMES IN: TORN ACL.|WE TRADE HIM TO BROOKLYN.

beats.head: BROOKLYN
beats.name: MELTON
beats.vo: He never played a single game for the Nets.

beats.head: HE'S BACK
beats.name: MELTON
beats.vo: Then we signed him back. Last season, he scored a career-high twelve point three a night.

beats.head: 10 GAMES IN
beats.name: MELTON
beats.vo: He re-signed this summer. Through ten games: forty-one point seven percent from three, and one point five steals.

facts.claim: Melton (No. 8) played 6 games for Golden State in 2024 before a partially-torn ACL; traded to Brooklyn on December 15, 2024 and never appeared for them (0 games); signed with Golden State October 1, 2025; career-high 12.3 points in 2025–26; re-signed August 1, 2026; a 3-point shooter
